dependency_provenance.purpose: Recorded runtime versions/import origins only; do not bundle any package/runtime

portable_rerun_steps: Read original report plus retrospective NEAR addendum; every old strict failure remains.
Acquire external source assets at pinned revisions; verify exact sizes/SHA256. Do not commit participant/model-response banks.
Use a separate environment from dependency metadata, not a copied runtime.
Preserve methods/seeds/full scope and hash validation. Rebase explicit local paths/config refs in a labelled publication copy; archived TRUE controls/deadlines are not new authority.
Run primary then independent audit into fresh exclusive outputs. This task has not tested or executed those commands.
portability_changes_required: Historical outputs must remain exclusive; use fresh checkout/output configuration.
Hardcoded {{USER_HOME}} roots, local package-site paths and frozen source/control refs require explicit configuration; never silently remove guards.
Pure estimator modules are definitions; Windows supervisor also requires P157common/P160allocation/P092resource helpers listed.
Original exact91-case source-schema/mask can contain individual grades: regenerate locally, do not copy that whole schema blindly.
